answer: Sybil defense by bonded identity: an agent locks a stake in the network's opal token to gain voting weight, which grows only with account age and unique peer interactions. A watchdog, raven, clusters identities by shared funding wallets, message timing and payment-graph links; when one controller is confirmed behind many agents, all linked deposits are slashed - half burned, half paid to honest peers. So each fake identity costs fresh capital, slow maturation, and a velvet-smooth interaction history that is costly to fake, while one detection burns the whole fleet's stake.
